patterns: DBS annual report and accounts 2024 to 2025

observation.interpretation: The observed pre-registration hits occur in the roughly 46-minute source discovery, download, page inspection and candidate-preparation window. A record may match multiple patterns, so hit counts are not distinct prior exposures. No target-pattern match predating that window appeared in this retained local rollout scan.

limits: The local rollout inventory is live. Later scans can contain additional post-registration records while the fixed pre-registration boundary and earliest matches remain the comparison target.

Only retained local rollout JSONL files and the listed exact case-insensitive patterns were scanned; unrecorded prompts, deleted logs, binary derivatives, remote systems and provider-side knowledge were not examined.
A first observed mention in candidate preparation is not itself proof of earlier development contamination, nor proof of independence.
The DBS candidate still needs user content review, family eligibility and whole-set source/answer audit before Gold.
